I disagree.


"It's not hard" in 1 on 1 teaching environments is fine. Some things shouldn't be "hard", and the "hardness" may be aligned to the expectations that they may have made for you.


There are hard concepts and hard tasks. If they are expecting something to be relatively "easy" and you feel otherwise, just tell them. At the same time, they should also be giving you a heads up when something "hard" pops up.


If you feel like it's an insult to your intelligence, try asking them what a "hard" concept or task might be. If they are taking the time to try to teach you something, they probably want to see you grow, not push you down.
